# InputPageBlockMap

## Documentation

A map. The map's width and height must not exceed 10000 in total, and width and height ratio must be at most 20.

### Parameters

- **`location`** ([`Location`](../messages_and_media/Location.md))
  Location of the map center.

- **`zoom`** (`int`)
  Map zoom level; 0-24.

- **`width`** (`int`)
  Map width; 0-10000.

- **`height`** (`int`)
  Map height; 0-10000.

- **`caption`** ([`PageBlockCaption`](PageBlockCaption.md) | [`RichText`](RichText.md) | `str`, *optional*)
  Block caption.
